notes.title: WILD Tactics - Behind the curtains - Devblog #1
notes.content:
[b]Heya, beautiful animals![/b]

WILD Tactics immediately caught the attention of many with a beautiful animated trailer showing off an action from our rookie team. It's fast-paced, colorful, and varied, with a graphical style that we in the team just call "Cartoon Network style". But the game is not for kids! That's why it's important to show another side of the game...

[previewyoutube=V6-rr6Lfbfw;full][/previewyoutube]

While the game is humorous, upbeat, and cool, there will be some very serious themes and a very deeply realized and unique world around it.

So we thought we'd mix styles, and while the 2D assets are done in a cartoon style that gives the game a fun and cool edge...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049062/090b4776485b66bc4ec0ca7d9420ef7e068d3001.jpg[/img]

...the gameplay is also beautifully and intricately rendered in 3D to reflect the more serious and gritty crime-noir side of the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049062/4d3e3f676874c0b159b8941bdbac544376ec5a92.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049062/1891f157c11413ebe3d8807f8292cae725d606a9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049062/efa80c8745b2bab9781927f9c7456fbad0d5e05b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049062/eee4f1867a6b604c936455782b08f6fff62622cc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049062/24d40242d5b2251f511d64a23795ae9389c22090.jpg[/img]

These two styles make up the truly unique atmosphere of WILD Tactics, a mix that will appeal to fans of turn-based strategy games and lovers of animal games and character-centric stories.

Take a peek at how characters are made, how we mix the styles, and how the development is going:

[previewyoutube=zrOlYWjolmw;full][/previewyoutube]

Have a wonderful week,
Stay awesome, you beautiful animals!
[i]The Wild Gentlemen - WILD Team[/i]

notes.title: The first gameplay trailer for WILD Tactics is here!
notes.content:
[b]We’re beyond excited to share the first gameplay trailer for WILD Tactics with you!
[/b]
This is an early pre-alpha look, so things will evolve, but we think it already captures the dynamic, colorful, and vibrant experience we’re aiming for. With 12 wild animal characters, each with unique personalities and abilities, we’re diving into a whole new side of the World of Wilderness.

We’ve poured our hearts into creating this game, packed with turn-based combat, gripping stories, and intense battles against powerful gangs.

Take a look at the trailer, and let us know what you think! We can’t wait to hear your thoughts.

[previewyoutube=zi3cwIHdwKc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Chicken Police: Into the HIVE! - is OUT!
notes.content:
WILD Tactics is not the only game set in the Wilderness. The second part of the multi-award-winning Chicken Police has just been released, it is called: Into the HIVE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45049062/77954bfbd860fcf6765cfdfff336d4cce19f4d1a.jpg[/img]

[h2]WHAT IS CHICKEN POLICE?[/h2]

Chicken Police: Into the HIVE! is a narrative-driven, "animal-noir-satire-adventure" where you play as Sonny Featherland and Marty MacChicken, the famous cop-duo called "The Chicken Police".

The game offers a city to explore, with jaw-dropping locations, amazing and weird characters, an original smoky, jazzy soundtrack, a complex and crazy conspiracy to uncover, and a 100% professional voiceover with a stellar cast!

The game is all about the characters and their relationships, interrogations, clue collecting, puzzle solving, and learning about the World of Wilderness. All this in a unique 2D-3D mashup style and a photomanipulation technique, and of course with a film-noir aesthetic.

[h2][b]FEATURES[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] more than 30 characters
[*] fully voiced by a stellar cast
[*] a thick noir atmosphere
[*] weird and buzzing locations
[*] a blood-pumping original soundtrack
[*] play in noir mode or in full (techni)color
[/list]

Check out our Launch Trailer:
[previewyoutube=WF0EFlSdVaw;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Chicken Police: Into the HIVE! is a deeply personal story set in a world, we created from scratch. It may resemble our world, but it has its own history, cultures, religions, political powers, and social constructs. [/i]

We hope you will enjoy the game we made with so much love and care! 
Please leave a review, and tell us what you think of it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362090/Chicken_Police_Into_the_HIVE/

Have an amazing day & week:
[i]The Wild Gentlemen[/i]

Join our Discord community and let's talk about the game or about games in general:
https://discord.gg/3na6emTAwr

notes.title: WILD Tactics is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43549437/7ffb7d8c556c5435097a922a96d9e8202b253950.jpg[/img]

WILD Tactics is a brand new tactical strategy/squad management game set in the World of Wilderness, with a focus on unique characters, social mechanics, and a hellishly wild narrative.

It features the well-known XCOM-like combat system with unique takes on the beloved gameplay mechanics.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43549437/5fe892dce79e430f0178e18a08efb34182ebc6c0.jpg[/img]

The game emphasizes the narrative as much as the combat! Get to know the ragtag crew of misfits, assemble your favorite team, and witness as the story unfolds through cutscenes and dialogues in 15 action-packed story-oriented missions.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43549437/56a8b2e097e62157cb66f6f2d433bf580f29c7f7.jpg[/img]

- 12 hero characters with deep backstories and complex relationships
- 15 huge story-oriented missions
- Plenty of side-missions
- Squad and base management
- Weapon upgrading
- A unique and meaningful social system
- And an amazing original soundtrack

[b]Wishlist it now![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2384640/WILD_Tactics/
